summary.marketScope: Instant Buyout only; owner confirmed in this follow-up. Ordinary online/offline offers excluded.
summary.scope: All128 original profiles checked against source,93 official wire stats, nine exact empty re-tests, seven one-filter controls; subsequent crafting-input review found six Jagged recipes incorrectly acquiring normal instead of rare. Three profile saves and one Physical Jagged relink correct them. Four affected rare query groups re-tested with real authenticated Instant Buyout data.
summary.priceScopeLimit: A zero is an observed Instant Buyout result for this exact query, not a claim of global market absence. A partial sample is not a complete price floor.
summary.snapshotStage: Initial stats/bounds snapshot before the later rarity fix; final runtime and mutation receipts are separate files.
summary.mechanicalValidation: Recipe/source agreement alone did not detect the same wrong rarity in both places. Full-reroll Jagged acquisition was reviewed separately.
